title: Ownership
intro: Who owns this property, from when, and in what share. A record is never changed: end it and add a new one.
emptyDetail: Add the owner so landlord views, portal access and the publish checks can use it.
endConsequence: The record is kept as history and cannot be reopened. To record a new share or owner, add a new record afterwards.
lastDayHelp: The owner still owns the property on this day.
reasonHelp: For example: sold, transferred, inherited, recorded in error.
newSubtitle: Record who owns a property or one of its units.
propertySearchHelp: Type at least two characters of the name, reference or address.
ownerHelp: Search contacts by name, phone or email.
coversHelp: Choose a unit when it has its own owner (for example a flat in a block).
shareHelp: Shares of one type for the same unit add up to at most 100 %.
shareInvalid: Enter a share above 0 and up to 100.
